item.title: About
item.description:
Hi, I’m Anil!

Cloud & Platform Engineer with 18+ years of experience in enterprise IT, including over 8 years in cloud-native and Kubernetes-based environments. Strong background in designing, building, and operating scalable multi-tenant platforms supporting data science, analytics, and compute-intensive workloads in regulated and enterprise environments.

Extensive hands-on experience with AWS, Kubernetes (OpenShift and EKS), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible), with a focus on automation, reliability, and secure platform design. Proven ability to develop and operate infrastructure services, tooling, and pipelines to support large-scale data and analytics platforms.

👋 Hi, I’m Anil!

I studied Computer Science Engineering and began my career in IT with a passion for technology and problem-solving. Over the years, that journey brought me to Switzerland — a move that was both exciting and challenging.

Relocating to a new country meant adapting to a different culture, language, and way of life. Fortunately, I was surrounded by a wonderful group of Indian colleagues who quickly became some of my closest friends. Their support and friendship made Switzerland feel like home from the very beginning. As new opportunities arose, I continued to grow both professionally and personally, building a life that I truly enjoy.

item.title: Work Experience
item.description:
Platform Architect – Posit Suite

Client: Takeda, Switzerland | Jan 2026 – Mar 2026

  • Designed and delivered a cloud-based Posit (RStudio) platform for enterprise analytics workloads
  • Built and operated AWS EKS-based infrastructure supporting data science teams
  • Ensured platform stability, scalability, and secure access for analytical workloads
  • Worked within a regulated environment including validation (IQ/OQ) and formal change control processes
  • Produced technical documentation and operational handover material for long-term support

Enterprise Cloud / Data Platform Engineer

Client: Takeda, Switzerland | Aug 2021 – Dec 2025

  • Designed, built, and operated AWS-based data platforms supporting enterprise analytics and data science teams
  • Owned Kubernetes (EKS) environments including upgrades, lifecycle management, and troubleshooting
  • Collaborated with data science teams to improve performance, stability, and usability of Databricks-based workloads
  • Implemented infrastructure automation using cloudformation and scripting to standardize deployments
  • Supported cost optimization and platform efficiency initiatives
  • Acted as technical bridge between platform engineering, data teams, and infrastructure stakeholders

Platform Engineer (OpenShift / Automation)

Client: Novartis, Switzerland | Aug 2017 – Aug 2021

  • Operated a multi-tenant container platform (OpenShift) supporting R and SAS-based analytics workloads and enterprise applications.
  • Automated platform provisioning, configuration management, and operational tasks using Ansible.
  • Supported Linux-based production environments through incident management, troubleshooting, performance analysis, and root cause investigation.
  • Collaborated with security, architecture, and application teams to ensure platform reliability, compliance, and operational efficiency.
  • Participated in release management, change implementation, and production support processes.
  • Contributed to continuous improvement of platform services supporting enterprise data and analytics workloads.

Application Hosting & Infrastructure Engineer

Client: Novartis | 2013 – 2017

  • Managed application hosting environments across web, application, and database layers
  • Supported deployments, releases, and production operations
  • Implemented backup, recovery, and system security processes
  • Resolved production incidents and contributed to root cause analysis

Earlier Roles (2006–2013)

Client: Novartis / Tata Teleservices | 2006 – 2013

  • Provided L2/L3 infrastructure support across enterprise environments
  • Performed incident management, problem analysis, and root cause investigations
  • Supported web and application platforms (Apache, WebLogic, IIS)
  • Built foundational experience in enterprise IT operations and troubleshooting

Professional Development:

  • Regular attendee of AWS and Red Hat technical conferences, community events, and cloud-native workshops
  • Continuously expanding knowledge in cloud architecture, Kubernetes ecosystems, platform engineering, and emerging AI/cloud technologies
